name: Demo: customer support SFT (alpaca)
description: 24 bilingual customer-support question/answer pairs in alpaca format. Trains directly with LoRA or full fine-tuning, no data preparation needed.

name: Demo: support chat (sharegpt)
description: 12 multi-turn support conversations in sharegpt format. Proves the sharegpt dataset path end to end.

name: Demo raw: product manual (document)
description: A 3.2k-character product manual. Run the Documents to Q&A pipeline to chunk the text and generate QA pairs.

name: Demo raw: noisy QA pairs
description: 16 low-quality, partly misspelled question/answer pairs. Run Noisy text to clean SFT to score, filter and rewrite them.

name: Demo raw: reasoning math
description: 12 math word problems with reference answers. Run Reasoning augmentation to generate and verify step-by-step solutions.

name: Demo raw: code samples
description: 10 instruction/code samples, including one test-only snippet that the pipeline drops. Run Code corpus to SFT.
